name: 學術詞表 Sublist 10
description: Coxhead 學術詞表（AWL）第十級：出現頻率最低但難度最高的 30 個字族，多見於嚴謹的學術論述與高分寫作。

words.definitionZh: 鄰接的、毗鄰的；緊靠在旁邊的

examples.sentence: The new laboratory was built on land adjacent to the main campus.
examples.translationZh: 新的實驗室蓋在緊鄰主校區的土地上。

words.definitionZh: 儘管、雖然（用於引出讓步，語氣較正式）

examples.sentence: The policy has reduced pollution, albeit at a considerable economic cost.
examples.translationZh: 這項政策確實減少了污染，儘管付出了相當高的經濟代價。

words.definitionZh: 集合、聚集；組裝、拼裝（零件）

examples.sentence: The research team assembled a large body of evidence before publishing its findings.
examples.translationZh: 研究團隊在發表結果之前蒐集了大量的證據。

words.definitionZh: 倒塌、崩潰；瓦解、失敗

examples.sentence: Overfishing led to the collapse of several coastal fish populations.
examples.translationZh: 過度捕撈導致數種沿海魚類族群的崩潰。

words.definitionZh: 同事、同僚；共事的專業人士

examples.sentence: She discussed the experimental design with colleagues from three other universities.
examples.translationZh: 她與來自另外三所大學的同事討論了實驗設計。

words.definitionZh: 編纂、彙整；蒐集資料整理成冊

examples.sentence: The agency compiled data from more than fifty monitoring stations.
examples.translationZh: 該機構彙整了超過五十個監測站的資料。

words.definitionZh: 構想、想出；設想、理解

examples.sentence: It is difficult to conceive of a society that functions entirely without written records.
examples.translationZh: 很難設想一個完全沒有文字紀錄仍能運作的社會。

words.definitionZh: 說服、使信服；令人相信某事為真

examples.sentence: The evidence was not strong enough to convince the committee to change its policy.
examples.translationZh: 這些證據不足以說服委員會改變其政策。

words.definitionZh: 使沮喪；使（價格、活動等）下降、壓低

examples.sentence: Rising interest rates tend to depress consumer spending.
examples.translationZh: 利率上升往往會壓低消費者的支出。

words.definitionZh: 遭遇、碰上（困難等）；相遇、接觸

examples.sentence: International students often encounter difficulties adapting to a new academic culture.
examples.translationZh: 國際學生在適應新的學術文化時經常遭遇困難。

words.definitionZh: 巨大的、龐大的；程度或數量極大的

examples.sentence: Renewable energy has enormous potential in regions with abundant sunlight.
examples.translationZh: 在日照充足的地區，再生能源具有巨大的潛力。

words.definitionZh: 即將到來的；（資源）可隨時取得的；願意提供訊息的

examples.sentence: The results will be presented at the forthcoming conference in Geneva.
examples.translationZh: 研究結果將在即將於日內瓦舉行的會議上發表。

words.definitionZh: 使傾向於、傾斜；斜坡、坡度

examples.sentence: Most economists are inclined to believe that the recovery will be gradual.
examples.translationZh: 多數經濟學家傾向於認為這次復甦會是漸進的。

words.definitionZh: 正直、誠信；完整性、未受損的狀態

examples.sentence: Academic integrity requires that all sources be properly acknowledged.
examples.translationZh: 學術誠信要求所有資料來源都必須被妥善註明。

words.definitionZh: 本質的、固有的；事物本身所具備的

examples.sentence: Children learn best when they feel intrinsic motivation rather than external pressure.
examples.translationZh: 孩子在感受到內在動機而非外在壓力時學得最好。

words.definitionZh: 援引、訴諸（法律、原則等）；喚起、引發

examples.sentence: The government invoked emergency powers to limit water consumption during the drought.
examples.translationZh: 政府在乾旱期間援引緊急權力以限制用水。

words.definitionZh: 徵收（稅捐、費用）；徵稅、稅款

examples.sentence: Several countries have levied a tax on single-use plastic bags.
examples.translationZh: 數個國家已針對一次性塑膠袋徵收稅金。

words.definitionZh: 同樣地、也；照樣地

examples.sentence: Urban air quality improved after the reform; rural areas benefited likewise.
examples.translationZh: 改革之後城市空氣品質改善了，鄉村地區同樣受惠。

words.definitionZh: 儘管如此、然而；雖然如此仍然

examples.sentence: The sample was small; nonetheless, the findings are worth further investigation.
examples.translationZh: 樣本數偏少；儘管如此，這些發現仍值得進一步研究。

words.definitionZh: 雖然、儘管；不受某事影響地

examples.sentence: Notwithstanding these limits, the study offers valuable insights.
examples.translationZh: 儘管有這些限制，這項研究仍提供了寶貴的見解。

words.definitionZh: 奇怪的、不尋常的；奇數的；零星的

examples.sentence: It seems odd that the two surveys produced such different results.
examples.translationZh: 這兩份調查得出如此不同的結果，似乎有些奇怪。

words.definitionZh: 持續進行中的；尚未結束的

examples.sentence: The ongoing debate about online privacy shows no sign of ending.
examples.translationZh: 關於網路隱私的持續辯論絲毫沒有結束的跡象。

words.definitionZh: 小組、專家評審團；嵌板、面板

examples.sentence: A panel of independent experts reviewed the environmental impact report.
examples.translationZh: 一個由獨立專家組成的小組審查了這份環境影響報告。

words.definitionZh: 堅持、固執；持續存在、延續

examples.sentence: Inequality in access to education persists despite decades of reform.
examples.translationZh: 儘管歷經數十年的改革，教育機會的不平等依然存在。

words.definitionZh: 造成（問題、威脅）；提出（問題）；擺姿勢、姿態

examples.sentence: Rising sea levels pose a serious threat to low-lying island nations.
examples.translationZh: 海平面上升對低窪的島國造成嚴重威脅。

words.definitionZh: 不情願、勉強；猶豫而不願為之的態度

examples.sentence: There is widespread reluctance among older workers to retrain in digital skills.
examples.translationZh: 年長勞工普遍不情願重新學習數位技能。

words.definitionZh: 所謂的（常帶質疑語氣，暗示名不副實）

examples.sentence: The so-called smart city projects have yet to deliver their promised benefits.
examples.translationZh: 這些所謂的智慧城市計畫尚未帶來所承諾的效益。

words.definitionZh: 簡單明瞭的、不複雜的；坦率直接的

examples.sentence: The procedure is straightforward enough for first-year students to follow.
examples.translationZh: 這個步驟夠簡單明瞭，一年級學生也能照著操作。

words.definitionZh: 經歷、接受（變化、檢驗、治療等）

examples.sentence: The city has undergone rapid transformation over the past two decades.
examples.translationZh: 這座城市在過去二十年間經歷了快速的轉變。

words.definitionZh: 藉此、憑此；用以說明方式或途徑的關係副詞

examples.sentence: The university introduced a scheme whereby students can study abroad for one semester.
examples.translationZh: 該大學推出一項方案，學生藉此可以出國研修一個學期。
